surfaceType: DigitalLife reconstructed subadult geometry and spot layout; revised albedo, fine normal detail and nonmetallic roughness
changes: Replaces the displayed CanYuTsai artist model with the requested DigitalLife Model99A. Native geometry, UVs, weights, joints and creator clip are retained without anatomical deformation or decimation. Albedo color response and fine detail are revised; source normal detail is combined with restrained continuous surface relief, roughness is rebuilt and eye response is separated. Display-only normalization and studio lighting.
biology: DigitalLife identifies the source as subadult male TZ209, Mosi, reconstructed from footage near Mafia Island, Tanzania in November2022. The model is a source reconstruction, not an independently certified scan or a complete physiological simulation.
